profile.summary: Highly motivated graduate with Scrum Master and Product Owner Certifications, adept at working in fast-paced environments, thrives on responsibility with intellectual challenges. Solutions-focused professional with self-efficacy and excellent track record of achievements within all facets of organizational management. Skilled-problem solver with the ability to communicate with users at all levels of technical proficiency. Ability to prioritize effectively, multi-task, achieve objectives while driving teams, and building strong relationships with key stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
